title: PulsePal — U.S. Cardiovascular Health Atlas
source: SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER — schema-compatible with CDC PLACES (age-adjusted prevalence). Not real data.

measures.label: High Blood Pressure
measures.description: Age-adjusted percentage of adults aged ≥18 who have ever been told they have high blood pressure (hypertension).

measures.label: Coronary Heart Disease
measures.description: Age-adjusted percentage of adults aged ≥18 who report having coronary heart disease.

measures.label: Stroke
measures.description: Age-adjusted percentage of adults aged ≥18 who report having had a stroke.

notes: These numbers are SYNTHETIC and for layout/QA only — do not cite them.
Geography is realistic (Stroke Belt & Appalachia run high) but values are generated, not measured.
State values are the unweighted mean of their counties.
Run `npm run data:scrape` after allowlisting data.cdc.gov to replace with real CDC PLACES data.
